title: Self-Tor homology as pushforward of a fixed pulled-back resolution
statement: For schemes Z and Y [def-pc-scheme], a closed immersion i:Z -> Y [def-weil-closed-immersion], and any supplied derived category on Y [def-pc-derived-category], let B=i_*O_Z and S be the degree-zero single functor. Let P be an integer-indexed cochain complex on Y [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], with a K-flat resolution a:P -> B[0] [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. Assume the tensor pullback functor i* [def-pc-module-pullback] is additive and put T=i*P termwise. For every integer k there is an isomorphism H^k(S(B) tensor^L S(B)) [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] with i_*H^k(T). The derived tensor is the fixed library tensor on the supplied category on Y. No flatness, regularity, boundedness, or chosen derived category on Z is assumed.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.22.1 (08EU); More on Algebra, Section 15.64 (068G); Modules Lemma 17.13.4 (08KS). Tensor and exact-pushforward part of step 2 of new-j3-self-ext-tor-core.

proof.text: Unfold the displayed lets and instantiate the intermediate projection/representative-comparison statement with Q=T and the identity isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem nonempty_selfTor_pushforward_homology {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] [IsClosedImmersion i] [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).Additive] (P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (a : P ⟶ (HomologicalComplex.single Y.Modules (.up ℤ) 0).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))) (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolution (R := Y.sheaf) a) (k : ℤ) : let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf) let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0 let T := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P Nonempty (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) k).obj (S.obj B ⊗ S.obj B)) ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (T.homology k))
